profile.headline: Sr. Web Developer at Texas Higher Education Coordinating Board

positions.title: Adjunct Instructor
positions.description: Adjunct Instructor in Communication Department teaching Presentational Speaking, Media Communication, Emerging Technologies, and Computer-Mediated Communication, and Interactive Media.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: As a member of the Web Services team at St. Edwards's University, I am responsible for assisting in the maintenance of our recruiting and community Drupal sites. I have also focused on web applications for faculty and staff using a variety of technologies including PHP, ColdFusion, Adobe Flash Media Server, and Adobe Flex. The majority of sites are created using the CakePHP MVC framework and web standards using HTML, CSS and Javascript. Currently, I am focusing on responsive design using HTML5 and Javascript to address both desktop and mobile sites.

company.name: The University of Texas at Austin

positions.title: Senior Developer
positions.description:
Developer on University of Texas at Austin redesign project using Drupal 7. Created custom modules as needed for use on the web site.

Contributor to internal reporting tool using NodeJs, Angular, and D3. My role in this project required me to use Lodash to export the data as json for use by charts created using D3.

Developed business-to-business request system using Laravel 4 to help potential clients at University of Texas at Austin request Springbox services

Assisted in maintenance of Air Force Academy website using WordPress.

Developed responsive website and emails campaign for McAfee using Zurb Foundation 5 and custom code for email templates

positions.title: Sr. FE Developer
positions.description: Focus on developing applications using a variety of technologies including: CodeIgniter, ExpressionEngine, AngularJS, jQuery, and MySQL.

positions.title: Developer
positions.description: Responsible for migrating existing code base from ASP to ASP.NET. Design modules using OOP methodologies for use both in ASP and ASP.NET. I was responsible for developing and supporting client forms for their events.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description: I was the sole web developer for PMCL (prior to merging with CDM) and was responsible for developing client sites. I also fostered relationships with local companies and organizations in the southern Illinois region as we developed their web presence. The majority of the sites were created using ASP and later, ASP.NET.
